name: How long does a short sale typically take in Florida?

mainEntity.name: How long does a short sale typically take in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timing of a short sale in Florida can vary significantly, usually ranging from 3 to 12 months, though some can take longer. Factors such as the lender's responsiveness, the complexity of your financial situation, and the number of liens on the property can affect the timeline. Process clarity dictates that thorough preparation of documentation and consistent follow-up with the lender are key to a more efficient process. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution works diligently to streamline communication and expedite the approval process for clients across Miami-Dade and Orange Counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Short sales in Florida typically take 3 to 12 months, depending on lender responsiveness and financial complexity. Thorough documentation and consistent follow-up can help expedite the process.
